title: Workshop: Brand Strategy
body: Develop and publish the Brand Strategy workshop page. Scope to include brand foundations, messaging frameworks, stakeholder insight, visual identity systems, and storytelling aligned with space and sustainability sectors. Define learning outcomes, agenda, delivery format, and target audience. Facilitator: Ryan Laird.

title: Workshop: ESG Growth Positioning
body: Create delivery materials and landing page for the ESG Growth Positioning Workshop. Focus on leveraging ESG credentials for brand differentiation, investor engagement, and sustainable business growth. Include objectives, case studies, and outcomes. Facilitator: Ryan Laird.

title: Workshop: Stakeholder Engagement Mapping
body: Design and document the Stakeholder Engagement Mapping Workshop. Hands-on B2B workshop covering stakeholder analysis, mapping frameworks, engagement strategies, and sustainability-aligned growth for space and technology sectors. Facilitator: Ryan Laird.

title: Workshop: Sustainability Action Plan
body: Develop Sustainability Action Plan workshop content covering baseline assessment, goal setting, roadmap development, KPIs, and monitoring for environmental and social impact. Produce facilitator notes and participant outputs. Facilitator: Ryan Laird.

title: Workshop: Sustainable Marketing
body: Create Sustainable Marketing workshop focused on integrating sustainability principles into campaigns, communications, and brand development. Participants design credible, impact-driven marketing strategies. Facilitator: Ryan Laird.

title: Workshop: Transition to Net Zero
body: Develop the Transition to Net Zero workshop. Cover practical carbon reduction strategies, operational alignment, Net Zero pathways, and implementation guidance for businesses. Include tools, templates, and action planning. Facilitator: Ryan Laird.

title: Masterclass: AI & Digital Skills
body: Build AI & Digital Skills masterclass covering AI productivity tools, automation workflows, data-informed decision making, digital ethics, and human-centred design. Tailored for organisational upskilling and digital transformation. Facilitator: Ryan Laird.

title: Masterclass: Campaign Planning
body: Develop Campaign Planning Masterclass focusing on audience analysis, messaging strategy, channel planning, and performance measurement. Include frameworks, templates, and real-world examples. Facilitator: Ryan Laird.

title: Masterclass: Space & Sustainability
body: Create Space & Sustainability masterclass exploring ESG standards, sustainable space operations, environmental reporting for space missions, and use of space data for terrestrial sustainability challenges. Audience includes industry leaders, engineers, investors, and policymakers. Facilitator: Ryan Laird.

title: Masterclass: Strategic Storytelling
body: Design Strategic Storytelling masterclass focused on narrative design, framing complex ideas, and persuasive communication for science, technology, and policy sectors. Include applied exercises and messaging frameworks. Facilitator: Ryan Laird.

title: Masterclass: Communications Excellence
body: Develop Communications Excellence masterclass for leaders and spokespeople. Cover message architecture, executive presence, media engagement, and strategic storytelling tailored to science, technology, policy, and innovation contexts. Facilitator: Ryan Laird.
